claims.quote: Each folder of [`../suites/`](../suites/) holds a suite with this layout, its tasks drawn from a benchmark of another field, so that Lion is measured by what others measure their tools with and not only by tasks written for it.
`openrulebench` | transitive closure with no argument bound and with the first bound, Join1, and DBLP
`bun run capability` grades each suite by its reference programs and prints its score beside the public tasks'.
`--agents` works the public and held-out tasks only, so an agents' run costs what it did.
The properties in `src/tests/capability.test.ts` make the reference programs of the public tasks and of every outside suite a ratchet
`sv-comp/gaps.json` says why `diamond_1` has no reference program yet, since Lion's solver cannot reason about the remainder of an unknown.
